title: 12 Best Craft Beer in Tallinn
description: Discover Tallinn's top 12 craft beer destinations for 2026. From industrial taprooms to cozy Old Town pubs, find your perfect pint with our expert guide.

places.name: Põhjala Brewery & Tap Room
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their Baltic Porter series or a fresh 'Virmalised' IPA. Don't miss their Texas-style BBQ ribs.

places.name: Koht
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the knowledgeable bartender for their latest unique tap or bottled discovery. They often have limited edition Estonian brews.

places.name: Uba ja Humal
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try one of their rotating taps from lesser-known Estonian breweries or pick out a unique bottle from their vast refrigerated selection.

places.name: Humalakoda
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their house-brewed lager or IPA, paired with the hearty schnitzel or a classic burger.

places.name: SIP vein ja õlletuba
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their seasonal craft beer recommendation or explore their selection of sour beers. They also have excellent cheese platters.

places.name: Brewery Õlleklubi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their Estonian craft lagers or an English ale from their extensive tap list. The hot wings are a popular snack.

places.name: Pööbel
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their famous black pudding (verivorst) if in season, or any of their robust mains, paired with a local craft IPA from their rotating taps.

places.name: Taps Craft Beer Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their constantly updated digital tap list for international craft beers, or ask for a flight to sample a few.

places.name: Drink Baar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Browse their extensive bottle menu, which is like a treasure hunt for beer lovers, or pick one of their craft taps.

places.name: Pudel Baar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A crisp local lager or a robust Baltic porter from a rotating Estonian microbrewery.

places.name: Väike Wiik
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for their current local tap, often featuring a smaller Estonian brewer, or enjoy a classic European craft beer.

places.name: Beer Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic German or Belgian craft beer, or one of the widely available Estonian craft staples. They also serve traditional pub food.
